_README: Collection definitions — the editorial shell for groups of related pieces. Membership itself lives on gallery rows (collection + part), curated in /admin. Plain JSON because two worlds read it: lib/collections.ts (typed, for the app) and scripts/chrome-blocks.mjs (plain ESM, for the bucket HTML injector). Keeping one file avoids the two drifting.

collections.title: The Political Ad Ledger
collections.blurb: A five-part read through India's political advertising disclosures — who buys, what they say, and what the ledger leaves out.

collections.title: Half a billion Amazon reviews
collections.blurb: Analyses over the Amazon Reviews 2023 corpus — 507.7M reviews across 33 product categories, 1996–2023.

collections.title: The Measure of Words
collections.blurb: A field booklet on text as data: dictionaries, topic models, and LLM measurement at scale.
